description: This file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot REST API, centralizing error handling for various exceptions and returning structured HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring ControllerAdvice class that handles exceptions globally across controllers and provides appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException and returns a 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles client-related exceptions and returns a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: handleServerError
methods.description: Handles generic exceptions and returns a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Builds a ResponseEntity with a structured JSON body containing error details.
